basis: Perspective and orthographic captures of the current ground-floor Three.js model. Living-room plan captured with a temporary 1.15m horizontal cut; garden overhead view hides the patio cover to show the tiled floor.

Keep the garden-side windows, radiators and white AC on LEFT wall. Clean grey floor tiles and off-white walls. Match crisp thin dark CAD outlines and restrained soft shading. Add plain white ceiling at existing wall height, no open-roof cutaway. Remove clutter, clothes, toys and cables. Natural level architectural perspective around 45-50mm lens, corrected verticals, no fisheye, no exaggerated foreground. No invented furniture, no labels, dimensions or text. Do not show neighboring houses or people through windows: use neutral soft daylight. One single landscape illustration.
